_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global leader in semiconductor memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge.' 'Volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2026 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K calls its own business cyclical ('If we choose to exercise such discretion due to the cyclicality of our business or other factors, we may not be able to fully utilize these incentives.' 'We may fail to achieve these milestones, in a timely manner or at all, due to a variety of factors, some of which may be outside of our control, including a cyclical downturn in our business or global downturn.'), words no earlier Micron 10-K uses; the company names the cyclicality of its own business, BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' and CAT's 'The demand for our products and services tends to be cyclical' reading, not AVGO's industry wording, so the kind is CYCLICAL, kept, the label only; the 10-K names AI only among the markets and applications Micron sells into ('DDR5 is the fifth generation of this technology and offers the critical improvements in bandwidth and power efficiency necessary to meet the growing needs of high-performance computing, AI, and data-intensive applications.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker (GENAI, live from 2022-11-30, is scoped to generative AI substituting the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content and mobility; EV, live from 2020-01-01, to combustion powertrains, auto parts and fuel retail; CRYPTO, live from 2020-10-21, to payments, banks and exchanges), so the watch list is empty

(FY2026 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K calls its own business cyclical ('If we choose to exercise such discretion due to the cyclicality of our business or other factors, we may not be able to fully utilize these incentives.' 'We may fail to achieve these milestones, in a timely manner or at all, due to a variety of factors, some of which may be outside of our control, including a cyclical downturn in our business or global downturn.'), words no earlier Micron 10-K uses; the company names the cyclicality of its own business, BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' and CAT's 'The demand for our products and services tends to be cyclical' reading, not AVGO's industry wording, so the kind is CYCLICAL, kept, the label only; the 10-K names AI only among the markets and applications Micron sells into ('DDR5 is the fifth generation of this technology and offers the critical improvements in bandwidth and power efficiency necessary to meet the growing needs of high-performance computing, AI, and data-intensive applications.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker (GENAI, live from 2022-11-30, is scoped to generative AI substituting the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content and mobility; EV, live from 2020-01-01, to combustion powertrains, auto parts and fuel retail; CRYPTO, live from 2020-10-21, to payments, banks and exchanges), so the watch list is empty. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.03x; +86% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.62; conservative 2yr +2071%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -57.0%/yr (worst year FY17-FY26 ex-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +350.9%/yr (Q1 FY27 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +350.9%/yr (FY17-FY26 ex-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +930.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY17-FY26 ex-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2026-11-06) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.03x (91.6% downside to Bear $57.75 / +3492.0% upside to Bull $24784.50) | Adj composite 3.85 vs market 1.22: gap +2.62 [UNDERVALUED] | +86% above the EPP floor $371.65 (5x FY27E $74.33) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2071.0% total (+1035.5%/yr) | At 9.3x FY27E the 15% hurdle price $912.52 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +379.3% YoY in Q4 FY26, forward revenues +339.8-361.8% (Q1 FY27 revenue guide (Q4 FY26 results (8-K ex.99.1, Business Outlook))); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
